lines.t: I ran the road that was white
Chasing dreams that never satisfied
Every promise faded fast
I was living for a moment that couldn't last
Then in the quiet of my doubt, I felt your love reach through the crowd
You didn't turn your eyes away, you called my name, you made a way
When I was lost and far from home, you were closer than I'd known
Grace was waiting where I stood, you are faithful, you are true
You found me, Yahushua, right where I was broken
You held me, never let me go, your love has spoken
I'm standing in your open arms
No fear, no shame, no chains on me
You found me, oh Lord
And now I'm finally free
The world said I should prove my worth
Carry the weight, earn my place on earth
But you said come just as you are
You healed my heart and raised the bar
Every scar says who you are
Mercy written in the dark
You traded crowns for wounded hands
So I could live inside your love
Oh, when my strength was running low
Your grace was more than I could know
You never left, you never moved
Every promise still stands secure
You found me, Yahushua
Right where I was broken
You held me, never let me go
Your love has spoken
And I'm standing in your open arms
No fear, no shame, no chains on me
You found me, Yahushua
And now I'm finally free
Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh
And now I'm finally free
Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh
Yeah, yeah
I don't have to earn your love
It was written from above
From the beginning you were near
Casting out my doubt and fear
Your light outshines my yesterday
You called me forward, not away
I'm alive because you came
I will never be the same
You found me, Lord
Love beyond all measure
You saved me, rewrote my story
You are my treasure
I will walk in all you've done
Every victory you've won
You saved me, Yahushua, my Savior, my King
You found me, Yahushua, right where I was broken
You held me, never let me go, Your love has spoken
I'm standing in Your open arms, no fear, no shame, no chains on me
You found me, oh Lord, and now I'm finally free
Every breath, every song, I belong where I belong
In Your grace, in Your truth All my hope is found in You
Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh And now I'm finally free
Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh
